### 3.2.1 Kc Curve Parameters

#### 3.2.1.1 Crops with Kc by Growth Phases

Chapter 6 - ETc - Single crop coefficient (Kc)
https://www.fao.org/4/X0490E/x0490e0b.htm
https://www.researchgate.net/figure/FAO-segmented-crop-coefficient-curve-and-four-growing-stages-after-Allen-et-al-1998_fig5_225419080
literature/FAO-segmented-crop-coefficient-curve-and-four-growing-stages-after-Allen-et-al-1998.pdf
"Kc_ini" value continues from "Sowing day" to "End of ini"
"Kc_mid" value continues from "End of Dev" to "End of Mid"
"Kc_end" is the value at "Harvest day"

##### 3.2.1.1 (a) Get Raw Kc Curve Parameter Table

```{r, kc-raw, eval=generate_kc, include=generate_kc}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Get parameters for FAO Segmented Crop Coefficient (Kc) curve by crop of each rotation ----
# From Laurent-Charlotte's Excel sheet
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Kc.raw <- readxl::read_xlsx("data/raw/Model in Excel/1 Kc Anantapur.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "Crop cycles Kc",
                                   range = "A2:AK16")

# Wrangle raw data to prepare Kc parameter table by DOY
# Remove columns with all NAs
Kc.raw <- Kc.raw[, !as.logical(sapply(Kc.raw, function(x)all(is.na(x))))]

# Remove unused row
Kc.raw <- Kc.raw[!Kc.raw$Date %in% c(NA, "Sowing_date"),]

Kc.raw$Date[1] <- "Sowing day"
Kc.raw$Date[nrow(Kc.raw)] <- "Harvest day"

# Header edits
colnames(Kc.raw)[1] <- "var"
colnames(Kc.raw)[2] <- "FORMULE"
Kc.raw$FORMULE <- as.numeric(as.character(Kc.raw$FORMULE))

# Remove header extras
cols.to.change <- colnames(Kc.raw)[stringr::str_detect(colnames(Kc.raw), "[...]")]

colnames(Kc.raw)[stringr::str_detect(colnames(Kc.raw), "[...]")] <- 
  gsub("...[0-9]*$", "", cols.to.change, perl = TRUE)

# Remove columns with no header and unused columns. Groundnut Kc Curves are coded later
Kc.raw <- Kc.raw[, -which(colnames(Kc.raw) %in% c("", "Groundnut_monsoon", "Groundnut_summer"))]

# Convert to numeric
# sapply(Kc.raw, class)
Kc.raw[-1] <- lapply(Kc.raw[-1], function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
# Verify the column classes
# sapply(Kc.raw, class)

# Save this data as raw input data
write.csv(Kc.raw, file = "data/raw/01_Crop_Kc_curve_parameters_Table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

##### 3.2.1.1 (b) Table of Crops Kc by Growth Phase DOY

```{r, kc-crops, eval=generate_kc, include=generate_kc}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# READ data/raw/01_Crop_Kc_curve_parameters_Table.csv ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Kc.raw <- read.csv(file = "data/raw/01_Crop_Kc_curve_parameters_Table.csv", header = TRUE)

# Separate crops by Rotation
Kc.raw.long <- Kc.raw %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -1, names_to = "crop") %>%
  mutate(crop = str_to_title(gsub("_|\\.", " ", crop, perl = TRUE)))
# unique(Kc.raw$var)
# [1] "Sowing day"   "Kc_ini"       "Ini_duration" "End of ini"   "Dev_duration" "End of Dev"  
# [7] "Kc_mid"       "Mid_duration" "End of Mid"   "Kc_end"       "End_duration" "Harvest day" 

# Only select rows with Kc values
Kc <- Kc.raw.long %>% 
  subset(var %in% Kc.raw$var[stringr::str_detect(Kc.raw$var, "Kc")]) %>%
  rename(Kc = value, Kc_var = var)

# Only select rows with DOY values
doy <- Kc.raw.long %>% 
  subset(var %in% c("Sowing day", "End of ini", "End of Dev", 
                    "End of Mid", "Harvest day")) %>%
  rename(doy = value, doy_var = var) %>%
# IF a doy is 365, it should be 366 to include leap years:
  mutate(doy = if_else(doy == 365.00, 366.00, doy))

Kc.doy.key <- data.frame(doy_var = c("Sowing day", "End of ini", "End of Dev", "End of Mid", "Harvest day"),
                           Kc_var = c("Kc_ini", "Kc_ini", "Kc_mid", "Kc_mid", "Kc_end"))

doy <- left_join(doy, Kc.doy.key, by = c("doy_var"))
Kc.doy <- left_join(doy, Kc, by = c("Kc_var", "crop")) %>%
  arrange(crop, doy, Kc) %>%
  mutate(doy = as.numeric(doy), Kc = as.numeric(Kc))

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# This is FAO Kc Parameter Table by DOY by Crop 
# SAVE data/processed/01_Crop_Kc_curve_parameters.csv ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Kc.doy.df <- Kc.doy %>% select(crop, doy_var, doy, Kc) %>%
  arrange(crop, doy, Kc) %>%
  rename(kc = Kc) 

write.csv(Kc.doy.df, file = "data/processed/05.1_Crops_Kc_by_Growth_Phase_DOY.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

##### 3.2.1.1 (c) Plot Segmented Crop Coefficient Curve

```{r, input-kc-curves, fig.show="hold", out.width="50%", eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.cap='Segmented Crop Coefficient Curve', include=TRUE}

kc.doy.ls <- split(kc.doy.crops, kc.doy.crops$crop.rotation)
kc.crops.ls <- lapply(kc.doy.ls, get_kc, from = as.Date("1970-01-01"), to = as.Date("1970-12-31"))

# par(mar = c(4, 4, .1, .1))
# knitr::include_graphics('figures/crop_kc_curves/MILLET_1.jpeg')
# knitr::include_graphics('figures/crop_kc_curves/GINGER_7.jpeg')

all.kc.figure.file <- "figures/crop_kc_curves/Segmented_Crop_Coefficient_Curves.pdf"
if (!file.exists(all.kc.figure.file)) {
  pdf(all.kc.figure.file, width = 7, height = 5)
    invisible(lapply(names(kc.crops.ls), function(crop.rotation) {
  ls <- kc.crops.ls[[crop.rotation]]
    plot(1, type="n", xlab="DOY", ylab="kc", xlim=c(0, 366), ylim=c(0, (max(ls$clim$kc)*1.1)),
         main=paste0(toupper(crop.rotation), "\nSegmented Crop Coefficient Curve"))
    lines(x=ls$clim$doy, y=ls$clim$kc, type="l")
    segments(x0=ls$kc.key$doy, y0=0, x1=ls$kc.key$doy, y1=ls$kc.key$kc, cex=.5, col="blue", lty="dotted")
    points(x=ls$kc.key$doy, y=ls$kc.key$kc, cex=.5, col="blue")
    text(x=ls$kc.key$doy, y=(ls$kc.key$kc)*1.05, labels=ls$kc.key$doy, cex=0.8, col="blue")
    text(x=ls$phase$phase.mid.doy, y=0.02, labels=ls$phase$phase, cex=0.8, col="dark red", srt=90, adj=0)
    text(x=ls$actions$doy + c(-7, 7), y= 0.02, labels=ls$actions$actions, cex=0.8, col="magenta", srt=90, adj=0)
  }))
dev.off()
}
```

#### 3.2.1.2 Crop with Kc by DOY Equation: Groundnut

##### 3.2.1.2 (a) Table of Crop Kc by DOY 1:366

```{r, kc-groundnut, eval=generate_kc, include=generate_kc}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Kc Equations for Groundnut ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Crop coefficient equation for groundnut (summer season)  (with R² = 0.9805)
# which we begin on the 10th of January
# Kc (d)=1.25*10^(-7)*d^4 - 2.82*10^(-5)*d^3 + 1.8*10^(-3)*d^2 - 2.49*10^(-2)*d + 0.3792
# Crop coefficient equation for groundnut (Rabi/monsoon season)  (with R² = 0.9734), 
# which we begin on the 1st of July 
# Kc (d)=1.32*10^(-7)*d^4 - 2.99*10^(-5)*d^3 + 1.96*10^(-3)*d^2 - 3.02*10^(-2)*d + 0.4

gm <- data.frame(d = 1:366) %>%
           mutate(crop = "Groundnut Monsoon",
                  Kc = 1.25*10^(-7)*d^4 - 2.82*10^(-5)*d^3 + 1.8*10^(-3)*d^2 - 2.49*10^(-2)*d + 0.3792)

gs <- data.frame(d = 1:366) %>%
  mutate(crop = "Groundnut Summer", 
         Kc = 1.32*10^(-7)*d^4 - 2.99*10^(-5)*d^3 + 1.96*10^(-3)*d^2 - 3.02*10^(-2)*d + 0.4)
kc_groundnut <- rbind(gm, gs)

write.csv(kc_groundnut, file = "data/processed/05.1_Crop_Kc_by_DOY_groundnut.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### 3.2.2 Generate Kc Curves 

```{r, generate-kc-curves, eval=generate_kc, include=generate_kc}
# This has data to produce Kc curves:
kc.doy.crops <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/05.1_Crops_Kc_by_Growth_Phase_DOY.csv", header = TRUE)
knitr::kable(head(kc.doy.crops[1:3,]))
# Are there parameteres present for all crop.rotations?
crop.all <- unique(crop.systems.l$crop[crop.systems.l$crop != "No_crop"])
kc.crop.matches <- match(crop.all, unique(kc.doy.crops$crop))
if (!any(is.na(kc.crop.matches))) {
  print("Kc curve parameters present for crops in all rotations.")
} else {
  print("Kc curve parameters not present for these crops:")
  print(crop.all[is.na(kc.crop.matches)])
}
# [1] "Kc curve parameters not present for these crops:"
#  [1] "No Crop"           "Grazed 1 Aug"      "Grazed 1 Sept"     "Grazed 1 Oct" 
#  [5] "Grazed 1 Nov"      "Groundnut Monsoon" "Napier Short"      "Napier"       
#  [9] "Groundnut Summer"  "Grazed Thrice" 

source("code/03_function_get_kc.R")
```
